strings:
A live stream page whose chat never rests, built from ordinary HTML
     for Noctiluca's tests: a playing video (media/card.webm, looping)
     beside a role=log panel (a scroll box) this page's own script
     fills many times a second, and a viewer count and a "now" strip above the video whose
     heights change as it does, so the page is laid out again and the
     video's box moves while it plays. Local: no network, no third-party
     assets. ?calm posts once a second instead.
